title: Is every flood caused by climate change?
hook_line: It would be wrong to say every forest fire is caused by climate change
why: Opens on a claim people don't expect from a climate scientist, resolves it with 'more likely, not always'.
comment_bait: Did you think every flood was climate change?
description: A flood scientist on what climate change does and does not cause.

title: How far ahead can we predict a flood?
hook_line: How good are we at predicting the next flood?
why: Asks the question everyone has, ends on a concrete number: two or three weeks.
comment_bait: How much warning would you need?
description: Earth-system models can now see floods, fires and heat waves coming weeks ahead.
